prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE production UI decal atlas for a Van Gogh-inspired VR gallery wooden sign.
Use the supplied sign screenshot only as a painting/material style reference and the supplied controller guide as a reference for painterly VR controller appearance. Do not reproduce the sign, room, navy backgrounds, lettering, or any border.
Output must have a genuinely transparent background. Wide 2:1 canvas, split into TWO equal square cells, empty clear gutter between cells. Both illustrations fit inside the central 65 percent of each cell, with generous transparent margins. Each cell is centered vertically and horizontally.
LEFT CELL: a small pair of recognizable ivory-white Meta Quest-style VR controllers, dark warm brown oval faces and small ochre buttons. Two controllers only, readable simple silhouettes, rough hand-painted impasto brushwork.
RIGHT CELL: a forked walking path shaped like a clear Y with two simple arrow ends; broad warm dark umber brush strokes with a few ochre/cream paint highlights, evoking choosing a route. Match the left illustration's scale, medium and line weight.
These will look hand-painted directly on a pale yellow wooden panel. Visible irregular brush edges, oil-paint pigment strokes, warm ivory, ochre and deep sepia palette. Strong readable contrast on pale yellow. Flat frontal painted emblems, no 3D extruded badge, no perspective, no drop shadow, no glow, no floating backplates, no rectangular outlines, no circles, no wood background, NO TEXT, no watermark. Keep the whole canvas except painted emblems transparent.
source: User-requested painterly icons for the pale wooden Gallery sign; original output retained in Codex generated_images.
